🏕️ Introduction

The campsite is equipped with a robust WiFi network designed to provide reliable internet access to all visitors. This system utilizes a NOS SIM card integrated into a 5G router, combined with strategically placed booster systems throughout the campsite to ensure strong and consistent coverage.

🔧 Hardware Components

🌐 Network Setup

Primary Connection: The 5G router connects to the NOS cellular network via the SIM card, delivering high-speed internet.

Signal Distribution: Booster systems amplify the router’s signal, ensuring coverage across the entire campsite, including remote areas.

SSID: The network is broadcast under the SSID Campsite_WiFi.

Security: WPA3 encryption is enabled to protect user data and prevent unauthorized access.

📍 Booster Placement Strategy

Near the main reception area to support administrative operations.

Around popular communal zones such as picnic areas and restrooms.

At the far ends of the campsite to cover remote camping spots.

⚙️ Maintenance and Troubleshooting

SIM Card Monitoring: Regular checks on data usage and signal quality to avoid service interruptions.

⚙️ Maintenance and Troubleshooting

SIM Card Monitoring: Regular checks on data usage and signal quality to avoid service interruptions.

Router Reboots: Scheduled weekly reboots to maintain optimal performance.

Booster Inspections: Monthly physical inspections to ensure devices are functioning and securely mounted.

User Support: On-site staff trained to assist visitors with connectivity issues.

📈 Performance Metrics

Average download speeds: 100-300 Mbps depending on location.

Average upload speeds: 50-150 Mbps.

Network uptime: 99.8% monthly.

📝 Summary

The campsite’s WiFi system leverages the latest 5G technology via a NOS SIM card and a network of boosters to deliver fast, reliable internet access to all guests. This setup ensures connectivity even in remote outdoor areas, enhancing the overall visitor experience.
